alt: 男孩沿著溪水流動的方向，輕推載著女孩的小木船。
scene_prompt: A quiet shallow stream flows visibly from upper left toward lower right with floating leaves. A person on the grassy bank gently pushes a small wooden rowboat in exactly the same direction as the flowing current; another person in the boat smiles as it glides easily downstream. The visible water flow assists the light push. Nature setting chosen to make adapting to circumstances clear.
